query: Create a Tough Tongue AI scenario for my SDRs to practice cold-calling leads who filled out a demo form for our payroll software. The AI should play the caller.
expected_behavior: Calls ttai:list_organizations before any other ttai tool and resolves whether to pass org_id
Classifies the scenario as a Cold Call and loads the matching ttai-agent recipe plus its authoring, model-selection, control, and instruction sources

Drafts from supplied lead facts with a two-beat opening and the recipe's three outcomes (CONVERTED / NURTURE / DEAD LEAD). Prefers Landmass Cascade and uses Ocean only when Cascade/Cartesia is unavailable; never invents a TTS voice ID.
Writes a rubrik that evaluates the LEAD (the human), not the AI caller
Calls ttai:create_scenario without an id field and returns the practice link https://app.toughtongueai.com/run/<scenario_id>

query: Here is a transcript of a call we lost on pricing objections: [transcript]. Build me a practice scenario so our reps can rehearse handling these exact objections.
expected_behavior: Classifies the scenario as Sales Roleplay (AI plays the prospect) and loads ttai-agent scenario-recipes/sales-roleplay.md
Extracts the actual objections from the pasted transcript and uses them as the scenario's core objections instead of inventing generic ones
Includes a resistance pattern (one objection at a time), breakthrough conditions, and early termination rules in ai_instructions
Writes a rubrik that evaluates the SALES REP with weighted categories
Creates via ttai:create_scenario and reports what was built in 2-3 sentences with the practice link

query: Our onboarding scenario keeps ending calls before the goodbye. Scenario name is 'Customer Onboarding Walkthrough'. Find out why and fix it.
expected_behavior: Resolves the exact scenario title via ttai:v3_list_scenarios, then fetches the full scenario with ttai:get_scenario
Pulls compact session evidence via ttai:v3_list_sessions filtered by scenario_ids, then inspects selected transcripts before proposing any edit
Loads ttai-agent's Scenario runtime guidance, diagnoses one root cause from the evidence, and distinguishes the prescribed behavior from what happened
Applies a surgical edit via ttai:update_scenario sending only id plus the changed fields
Reports diagnosis, change summary, token delta estimate, and the new-sessions-only reminder
